_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-12 (WF13 schema migration + V1.1 reconciliation). Live ID: ax2sMbvv0lqyJHMg. Phase 3 workflow. Form URL: https://valfin.app.n8n.cloud/form/eca6bfbb-ef53-4f82-b909-cbd2b818991a. V1.1: structured date picker + 30-min time-slot dropdown (8AM-5PM America/New_York), CONFIG block in 'Build Booking Payload', Luxon-based timestamps, AI lead-scoring fields removed. 2026-06-12: 'Write Appointment' seeds 'Notified Appt Date'/'Notified Appt Time' = the booked Appt Date/Time (correct baseline for WF13), and 'Notify Customer' = false / 'Reschedule Status' = 'None' / 'Reschedule Attempts' = 0 (defaults for the owner-controlled reschedule-notification flow — see CRM_SHEET_SCHEMA.md and workflows/13_appointment_reschedule_notifier.json).
name: Appointment Booking

parameters.formDescription: Enter the Lead ID and appointment details. The customer will receive a confirmation SMS automatically.

parameters.content: This workflow processes appointment requests submitted through a booking form (separate date picker + 30-minute time-slot dropdown, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM America/New_York), verifies the lead in the CRM, records the appointment details, sends a confirmation SMS to the contact, and updates the CRM with the booking activity. Scheduling assumptions (timezone, business hours, slot increment) are centralized as CONFIG constants at the top of 'Build Booking Payload' for easy per-client reconfiguration.
